Package io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style

Class SldBuilder

java.lang.Object
io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldBuilder
public final class SldBuilder extends Object
Fluent builder for SLD 1.0 (Styled Layer Descriptor) style documents.

Mirrors the scope of GeoTools StyleBuilder / StyleFactory without requiring any GeoTools dependency. All output is well-formed SLD 1.0 XML serialized into a StyleContent object ready for upload via StyleManager.create(String, StyleContent).

Symbolizers supported

  • Point — well-known marks (WellKnownName), external graphic images, and external marks (TTF font glyphs); fill, stroke, size, rotation, opacity
  • Line — stroke colour, width, opacity, dash pattern, dash offset, line-cap, line-join, perpendicular offset, graphic fill, graphic stroke
  • Polygon — solid fill with opacity, graphic fill pattern, outline stroke (all stroke options), graphic stroke on outline
  • Text — font family (with fallback list), size, bold, italic, oblique; halo radius and colour; point placement (anchor, displacement, rotation) or line placement (perpendicular offset); GeoServer vendor options
  • Raster — opacity, channel selection (gray / RGB with per-channel contrast enhancement and gamma), global contrast enhancement, overlap behaviour, colour map (ramp / intervals / values, extended), shaded relief, image outline

SLD document structure

  • Root: <StyledLayerDescriptor version="1.0.0">
  • Exactly one layer per builder: <NamedLayer> (create(java.lang.String)) or <UserLayer> (createUserLayer(java.lang.String))
  • One or more <UserStyle> blocks (userStyle())
  • Optional <NamedStyle> references (namedStyle(String))
  • One or more <FeatureTypeStyle> blocks per UserStyle (featureTypeStyle())
  • One or more <Rule> blocks per FeatureTypeStyle (rule(String))
  • Optional <LayerFeatureConstraints> (layerConstraint(java.lang.String, io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilter))

Full fluent example — all symbolizer types


 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.OgcFilters.*;
 import static io.github.kimbongjune.geoserverclient.dto.style.SldExpression.*;

 StyleContent sld = SldBuilder.create("my_layer")
     .styleName("full-demo")
     .title("Full symbolizer demo")
     .isDefault(true)

     // ── FeatureTypeStyle 1: point features ──
     .featureTypeStyle("points")
     .rule("cities-large").filter(greaterThan("population", 1_000_000))
         .mark(WellKnownName.CIRCLE)
             .fill("#FF4444", 0.9)
             .stroke("#880000", 1.5)
             .size(property("population_rank"))   // proportional symbol
             .rotation(45)
         .end()
         .label("name")
             .font("Arial", 14).bold()
             .color("#FFFFFF")
             .halo("#000000", 2)
             .vendorOption("maxDisplacement", "40")
             .vendorOption("conflictResolution", "true")
         .end()
     .rule("cities-small").elseFilter()
         .point(WellKnownName.CIRCLE, "#AAAAFF", 6)

     // ── FeatureTypeStyle 2: line features ──
     .featureTypeStyle("lines")
     .rule("highways").filter(equalTo("road_class", "highway"))
         .stroke("#CC0000", 4)
             .dashArray("10 4")
             .lineCap(LineCap.ROUND)
             .lineJoin(LineJoin.ROUND)
         .end()
         .textOnLine("name", "#333333", "Arial", 11, 6)

     // ── FeatureTypeStyle 3: polygon features ──
     .featureTypeStyle("polygons")
     .rule("parks").filter(equalTo("landuse", "park"))
         .fill("#336633")
             .fillOpacity(0.75)
             .stroke("#114411", 1)
         .end()

     // ── FeatureTypeStyle 4: raster DEM ──
     .featureTypeStyle("dem")
     .rule("dem-rule")
         .rasterBuilder()
             .opacity(1.0)
             .channelGray("1", ContrastMethod.NORMALIZE)
             .colorMap(SldColorMapType.RAMP,
                 SldColorMapEntry.of("#0000FF", 0,   "Low"),
                 SldColorMapEntry.of("#00FF00", 500,  "Mid"),
                 SldColorMapEntry.of("#FF0000", 1000, "High"))
             .shadedRelief(55, false)
         .end()

     .build();

  • Method Details

    • create

      public static SldBuilder create(String layerName)
      Creates a new SldBuilder for a <NamedLayer>.

      A <NamedLayer> references an existing layer published in GeoServer by name. This is the most common starting point for styles uploaded via StyleManager.create() or StyleManager.update(). 

      
 StyleContent sld = SldBuilder.create("topp:tasmania_roads")
     .rule("all").line("#CC0000", 2).build();
      Parameters:
      layerName - the GeoServer layer name (may include workspace prefix, e.g. "topp:tasmania_roads"); must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      a new SldBuilder targeting a <NamedLayer>
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if layerName is null or empty

    • createUserLayer

      public static SldBuilder createUserLayer(String name)
      Creates a new SldBuilder for a <UserLayer>.

      A <UserLayer> is used when styling inline or remote data not yet published as a named GeoServer layer. Attach a remote WFS or WCS data source with remoteOws(String, String). The resulting SLD is typically submitted directly as part of a WMS SLD parameter rather than stored as a named style. 

      
 StyleContent sld = SldBuilder.createUserLayer("mydata")
     .remoteOws("WFS", "http://example.com/geoserver/wfs")
     .layerConstraint("sf:archsites", null)
     .rule("all").point(WellKnownName.CIRCLE, "#FF0000", 8).build();
      Parameters:
      name - the user layer name; must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      a new SldBuilder targeting a <UserLayer>
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if name is null or empty

    • styleName

      public SldBuilder styleName(String name)
      Sets the <Name> element of the current <UserStyle>.

      This name identifies the style variant within the layer — it is separate from the layer name set in create(String). GeoServer uses it when the client requests a specific named style via WMS STYLES parameter.

      Parameters:
      name - the style name; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • title

      public SldBuilder title(String title)

      The title appears in legend displays and GetCapabilities responses.

      Parameters:
      title - a short, human-readable title; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • isDefault

      public SldBuilder isDefault(boolean value)
      Controls whether the current <UserStyle> is marked as the default style for the layer (<IsDefault>1</IsDefault> in the SLD output).

      GeoServer renders the default style when the client does not explicitly request a named style. Exactly one UserStyle per layer should be marked as default.

      Parameters:
      value - true to mark as default; false (the factory default) otherwise
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • userStyle

      public SldBuilder userStyle()
      Starts a new anonymous <UserStyle> block within the same layer.

      All subsequent rule() calls target this new UserStyle block. Multiple UserStyles within a single layer allow the WMS client to select which variant to render using the STYLES parameter.

      Returns:
      this builder for chaining (now targeting the new UserStyle)

    • userStyle

      public SldBuilder userStyle(String name)
      Starts a new named <UserStyle> block within the same layer.

      Equivalent to userStyle() followed immediately by styleName(String).

      Parameters:
      name - the <Name> of the new UserStyle block
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining (now targeting the new UserStyle)

    • namedStyle

      public SldBuilder namedStyle(String styleName)
      Adds a <NamedStyle> reference to the layer.

      A <NamedStyle> refers to an existing server-side style by name without embedding any rules. Use buildForNamedStyle() to finalize the SLD when only NamedStyle references are present (no inline rules). 

      
 StyleContent sld = SldBuilder.create("roads")
     .namedStyle("point")
     .buildForNamedStyle();
      Parameters:
      styleName - the server-side style name to reference; must not be null
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • featureTypeStyle

      public SldBuilder featureTypeStyle()
      Starts a new anonymous <FeatureTypeStyle> block within the current UserStyle.

      Subsequent rule() calls add rules to this new block. Multiple <FeatureTypeStyle> blocks are rendered in document order, which controls the z-order of drawn features. For example, placing a road-casing FTS before a road-fill FTS achieves an outline effect.

      Returns:
      this builder for chaining (now targeting the new FeatureTypeStyle)

    • featureTypeStyle

    • ftsFeatureTypeName

      public SldBuilder ftsFeatureTypeName(String name)
      Sets the <FeatureTypeName> constraint on the current <FeatureTypeStyle>.

      When set, this FeatureTypeStyle block is applied only to features of the specified type. Useful when a layer contains multiple feature types.

      Parameters:
      name - the feature type name (e.g. "sf:archsites")
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • ftsSemanticTypeIdentifier

      public SldBuilder ftsSemanticTypeIdentifier(String identifier)
      Sets a <SemanticTypeIdentifier> on the current <FeatureTypeStyle>.

      The semantic type identifier is a hint to the renderer about what geometry type the FTS applies to. Common values:

      • "generic:geometry" — any geometry
      • "generic:point" — point geometries
      • "generic:line" — line/linestring geometries
      • "generic:polygon" — polygon geometries
      • "generic:raster" — raster/coverage data
      Parameters:
      identifier - the semantic type identifier string
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • layerConstraint

      public SldBuilder layerConstraint(String featureTypeName, OgcFilter filter)
      Adds a <FeatureTypeConstraint> to the layer's <LayerFeatureConstraints>. This constrains which features the style applies to.
      Parameters:
      featureTypeName - the feature type name (may be null for wildcard)
      filter - the OGC filter to apply (may be null for no filter)
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • layerConstraint

      public SldBuilder layerConstraint(String featureTypeName, OgcFilter filter, double minX, double minY, double maxX, double maxY)
      Adds a <FeatureTypeConstraint> with a spatial <Extent> (BBOX) constraint. The <Extent> element limits rendering to features within the given bounding box.
      Parameters:
      featureTypeName - the feature type name (may be null)
      filter - the OGC filter (may be null)
      minX - western extent
      minY - southern extent
      maxX - eastern extent
      maxY - northern extent
      Returns:
      this builder for chaining

    • rule

      public SldBuilder.RuleBuilder rule()
      Starts a new auto-named <Rule> in the current <FeatureTypeStyle>.

      The auto-generated name is "rule" followed by the one-based index of the rule within the current FTS (e.g. "rule1", "rule2").

      Returns:
      a new SldBuilder.RuleBuilder for the auto-named rule

    • rule

      public SldBuilder.RuleBuilder rule(String name)
      Starts a new named <Rule> in the current <FeatureTypeStyle>.

      Rule names appear in legend labels and are referenced by some GeoServer features (e.g. legend icons). Use descriptive names like "highways" or "parks".

      Parameters:
      name - the rule name; must not be null or empty
      Returns:
      a new SldBuilder.RuleBuilder for the named rule

    • build

      public StyleContent build()
      Builds and returns the complete SLD 1.0 document as a StyleContent.

      At least one rule must have been added to at least one UserStyle before calling this method. Use buildForNamedStyle() instead when only namedStyle(java.lang.String) references were added.

      Returns:
      a StyleContent containing the serialized SLD XML, ready for upload via StyleManager.create() or StyleManager.update()
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no rules were added and no NamedStyle references exist

    • buildForNamedStyle

      public StyleContent buildForNamedStyle()
      Builds the SLD document for a layer that contains only <NamedStyle> references (no inline rules).

      Use this variant when all style references were added via namedStyle(String) and no rules were added via rule(String). Calling build() in this scenario would throw because there are no inline rules; this method skips that check.

      Returns:
      a StyleContent containing the serialized SLD XML
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if no NamedStyle references have been added
